technical_and_design_decisions: Target platform is the Spring XD 1.1 codebase (Java 8, Spring Framework 4.x, Gradle build system), consistent with the 1.0-to-1.1 migration context of the user stories.

U1: Deliver migration support as a combination of a documented 1.0->1.1 module migration guide plus hands-on verification by porting representative sample custom modules (source/sink/processor) to the 1.1 module API; no automated migration tooling will be built.
U2: The Pig sample will be implemented as an XD batch job module wrapping a Pig script via Spring Hadoop (SHDP), with a small integration test and README documentation.

U3/U4: Windows support will reuse the existing Gradle build; Unix shell scripts will be mirrored with Windows batch/PowerShell equivalents, and path/line-ending/encoding issues in build and test code will be fixed rather than introducing a separate build system.
U4: A dedicated EC2 Windows Server AMI will be provisioned (JDK, Git, Gradle, XD runtime preinstalled); acceptance tests will run via a new Jenkins CI plan triggered on demand and nightly.

U5: Spark Streaming processors will be implemented twice as separate XD processor modules - one in Java 8 using lambdas and one in Scala - both built against Spark 1.x streaming API, sharing a common test fixture and documented usage examples.

U7: Kafka support will be upgraded by first backporting XD-specific Kafka enhancements into the Spring Integration Kafka extension, then bumping XD to the SI Kafka GA release and adapting to any API changes.
U8: Hadoop integration will be upgraded to the Spring Hadoop (SHDP) GA release via dependency version bump plus adaptation of any changed APIs/configuration.
U6: The copyright year is maintained in the documentation build configuration (Asciidoc/DocBook attributes) so the reference guide PDF regenerates with the updated 2015 notice.
All code changes follow the existing project conventions: Gradle modules, JUnit-based unit/integration tests, and documentation in the reference guide.
assumptions: A single developer (the author) performs all work; estimates are pure effort in work-hours, not calendar time, and exclude waiting/review time by third parties.
The developer is already familiar with the Spring XD codebase, Gradle, Spark, Kafka, Spring Integration, Spring Hadoop, and AWS EC2, so no learning-curve allowance is included.

An AWS account with permissions to create Windows Server AMIs and EC2 instances is available at no additional procurement effort; a Jenkins CI server is available for the new Windows acceptance-test plan.
The XD 1.0 and 1.1 codebases, existing acceptance-test suite, and sample custom modules are available as starting points.
The SI Kafka GA and SHDP GA releases are publicly available and largely API-compatible; upgrade effort covers adaptation and regression verification only.
No clarifying information is required from stakeholders; ambiguities are resolved by the technical decisions listed above.
One work-hour equals one hour of focused development, testing, or documentation work.

activities.activity_name: Project analysis and environment setup
activities.activity_description: Review all eight user stories, inspect the XD 1.0/1.1 codebases, set up development environments (Linux and Windows), CI access, and AWS credentials.

activities.activity_name: U1 - Analyze XD 1.0 to 1.1 module API differences
activities.activity_description: Diff module definition, packaging, and deployment APIs between XD 1.0 and 1.1; catalogue breaking changes affecting custom modules and data pipelines.

activities.activity_name: U1 - Port and validate sample custom modules
activities.activity_description: Port representative custom source, processor, and sink modules from 1.0 to 1.1, run them against existing data pipelines to verify operationalization works.

activities.activity_name: U1 - Write migration guide
activities.activity_description: Author the 1.0-to-1.1 migration documentation covering module porting steps, pipeline migration, and new 1.1 features relevant to users.

activities.activity_name: U2 - Implement Pig job sample module
activities.activity_description: Create a sample Pig script and an XD batch job module that executes it via Spring Hadoop, including configuration metadata.

activities.activity_name: U2 - Test and document Pig sample
activities.activity_description: Add an integration test running the Pig job in XD and write reference documentation/README showing how to integrate Pig jobs in XD.

activities.activity_name: U3 - Fix Windows build issues
activities.activity_description: Resolve path separator, line-ending, encoding, and shell-script problems in the Gradle build; provide Windows batch/PowerShell script equivalents; fix platform-sensitive tests.

activities.activity_name: U3 - Validate full build on Windows
activities.activity_description: Run the complete XD build with unit and integration tests on a Windows machine, iterate on failures until the build is green, and document Windows build instructions.

activities.activity_name: U4 - Provision EC2 Windows image
activities.activity_description: Create and configure a Windows Server AMI on EC2 with JDK, Git, Gradle, and XD runtime prerequisites; script the provisioning for repeatability.

activities.activity_name: U4 - Adapt and run acceptance tests on Windows
activities.activity_description: Adapt the acceptance-test suite for Windows (paths, process management, ports), execute the full suite on the EC2 Windows environment, and fix discovered issues.

activities.activity_name: U4 - Create Windows acceptance-test CI build
activities.activity_description: Configure a Jenkins CI plan that launches/uses the EC2 Windows node and runs the acceptance-test suite on a scheduled and on-demand basis.

activities.activity_name: U5 - Design Spark Streaming processor modules
activities.activity_description: Define the XD processor module contract for Spark Streaming (options, input/output binding, checkpointing) shared by the Java and Scala implementations.

activities.activity_name: U5 - Implement Java Spark Streaming processor
activities.activity_description: Implement the Spark Streaming processor module in Java 8 using Java lambdas against the Spark 1.x streaming API.

activities.activity_name: U5 - Implement Scala Spark Streaming processor
activities.activity_description: Implement the equivalent Spark Streaming processor module in Scala, including the Scala build wiring in Gradle.

activities.activity_name: U5 - Test and document Spark Streaming processors
activities.activity_description: Write unit and integration tests for both processor variants and produce user documentation with example stream definitions demonstrating the capabilities.

activities.activity_name: U6 - Update copyright in reference guide PDF
activities.activity_description: Update the copyright year from 2014 to 2015 in the documentation build configuration and regenerate/verify the reference guide PDF.

activities.activity_name: U7 - Backport Kafka XD changes to SI Kafka
activities.activity_description: Backport XD-specific Kafka enhancements and fixes into the Spring Integration Kafka extension in preparation for the GA release alignment.

activities.activity_name: U7 - Upgrade XD to SI Kafka GA
activities.activity_description: Bump the Kafka integration dependency to the SI Kafka GA release, adapt XD Kafka source/sink modules to API changes, and run Kafka-related integration tests.

activities.activity_name: U8 - Upgrade to SHDP GA release
activities.activity_description: Upgrade the Spring Hadoop dependency to the GA release, adapt configuration and Hadoop job modules (including the Pig sample) to any changes, and verify with tests.

activities.activity_name: Cross-cutting integration and regression testing
activities.activity_description: Run full regression and integration test suites across Linux and Windows covering all increment changes (migration, Pig, Spark, Kafka, SHDP) and fix defects found.

activities.activity_name: Final documentation and release preparation
activities.activity_description: Consolidate reference guide updates, release notes for all eight user stories, version bumps, and final packaging verification of the increment.
